hypotheses.justification: `SeriesPoint Φ τ` has an `AddGroup` instance with no conditions (`SeriesPoint.instAddGroup` in Definitions/Def_MvFormalGroup_WittPointFamily.lean, line 58). Only the `AddCommGroup` instance needs `[Φ.IsComm]`. So without the hypothesis, `a - b` still elaborates, using the subtraction that `SubNegMonoid` defines by default as `a + -b`. The proof goes through unchanged. `sub_eq_add_neg` holds in any `SubNegMonoid`. `PInI.add` (line 199) and `PInI.neg` (line 216) are stated in the same section without `[Φ.IsComm]`, so they do not need it. Commutativity is never used. No degenerate case matters, because the argument is purely algebraic and works for every `Φ`, `τ` and `n`.
